title: CPU spike environment for S4, S6 and I-R2
question: Do rule-engine, jsonschema, z3-solver, psycopg (binary), pgvector and gliner2 with its local-inference stack install and work on Python 3.14.10 alongside the E0 set, on the CPU torch 2.14.1?
method: Exact pins added to the spike uv project (gliner2 with its `local` extra, corpus-evidence as an editable path source); uv lock and uv sync into build/spike-venv; the E0 import set plus the new modules imported, and functional checks: a z3 solve, a GLiNER2 Schema dict round trip, a rule-engine rule, psycopg's libpq implementation.

results.name: gliner2
results.note: pure-Python wheel; `local` extra resolves transformers 5.21.0, peft 0.21.2, accelerate 1.15.0, safetensors 0.8.0 on torch 2.14.1+cpu; engine module imports

results.name: z3-solver
results.note: wheel installs on 3.14; trivial solve sat with x=7, y=3

results.name: rule-engine
results.note: requires python-dateutil~=2.7, which moved python-dateutil 3.0.0 -> 2.9.0.post0 for the whole environment

results.name: jsonschema
results.note: now declared (was transitive at the same version)

conclusion: Every E4a package installs and works on Python 3.14.10 with the CPU torch 2.14.1; gliner2 2.1.0 (with its local-inference stack) and z3-solver 5.3.2.0 have 3.14-compatible wheels, settling those two parts of OPEN-D9-1. No package was blocked.
